exposure: number of attempts for spinal anesthesia
outcome: Failed spinal anesthesia (FSA) for cesarean section
cohort: The study enrolled 241 women (Mean+/-SD age of 29.54+/-6.64 years, BMI of 27.98+/-3.16 kg/m2) who underwent elective and emergency cesarean section under spinal anesthesia (ASA-I and ASA-II).
finding: The overall incidence of failed spinal anesthesia (FSA) for cesarean section was 7.9%, with significant predictors including higher BMI, emergency surgeries, level of anesthesia residency, bloody CSF, the number of attempts, and ASA class.
